Geographic Information Systems Market Set to Surge: A $44 Billion Opportunity by 2034

March 27, 2026 GIS market, location intelligence, geospatial analytics, smart cities, growth forecast
Read the source article

Quick summary

A market overview cites research projecting strong GIS growth through 2034, driven by smart‑city investment, cross‑industry adoption, and AI‑enabled geospatial analytics.

Key takeaways

  • The GIS market is forecast to grow from about $15B (2025) to $44B (2034).
  • Smart‑city initiatives and urban planning are highlighted as major drivers.
  • GIS adoption is expanding across sectors such as agriculture, logistics, and utilities.
  • AI/ML, cloud, and remote sensing are accelerating geospatial analytics capabilities.
  • Challenges include implementation costs and data quality/privacy constraints.
